mutations.name: the gate result is ignored when errors are held
mutations.find: if (held > 0) throw new QaRefused(input.stem, qaJson, held);
kills: renderVideo's QA gate refuses the seeded overlap page before it mixes or encodes anything

mutations.name: skip mode runs the gate anyway
kills: renderVideo's QA gate renders the seeded overlap page unchecked in skip mode and records the skip

mutations.name: a passing gate is recorded as absent
mutations.find: return { qaGate: "passed", qa: { heldErrors: 0, gateProfile: input.qa.gate.sha } };
kills: renderVideo's QA gate records a clean page's gate as passed with no held errors

mutations.name: a stale qa.json survives the next render
kills: renderVideo's QA gate removes a qa.json left by an earlier refused render when the next one skips the gate

mutations.name: the gate runs after the mix is written
kills: renderVideo's QA gate refuses the seeded overlap page before it mixes or encodes anything
